<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>A股自动选股实验室 V2</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f6f8;--panel:#fff;--ink:#17212f;--muted:#667085;--line:#d9e0e7;--accent:#126b61;--green:#138a58;--red:#bc3a37;--blue:#2764a5;--warm:#9a5b16}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}header{background:#112329;color:#fff;padding:22px clamp(16px,4vw,42px)}header h1{margin:0;font-size:30px}header p{margin:8px 0 0;color:#c8d8dd}.wrap{padding:22px clamp(14px,3vw,42px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:320px 1fr;gap:18px}.panel{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(27,39,57,.08);min-width:0}.controls{padding:16px;display:grid;gap:14px;align-content:start}.field{display:grid;gap:7px}label{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}input,select{width:100%;min-height:40px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 10px;font:inherit}.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}button{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font:inherit;font-weight:700;min-height:40px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer}.secondary{background:#fff;color:#17212f;border-color:#cbd5df}.notice{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#69430f;background:#fff8ed;border:1px solid #e4cda7;border-radius:8px;padding:12px}.content{display:grid;gap:18px}.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:10px}.metric{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:13px}.metric span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.metric strong{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:22px}.head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;padding:16px}.head h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}.head p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-align:right}.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line);max-height:460px}table{border-collapse:collapse;min-width:1100px;width:100%;background:#fff}th,td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 10px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px}th:first-child,td:first-child,th:nth-child(2),td:nth-child(2),th:nth-child(3),td:nth-child(3){text-align:left}th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#f0f3f6;color:#52606f}.tag{display:inline-flex;border-radius:999px;background:#edf3f8;color:#31566d;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.pos{color:var(--green);font-weight:700}.neg{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}.blue{color:var(--blue);font-weight:700}.warm{color:var(--warm);font-weight:700}.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px;padding:0 16px 16px}.card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:14px;display:grid;gap:10px}.card h3{margin:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}.scores{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px}.score{background:#f5f7f9;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 6px;text-align:center}.score span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.score strong{display:block;margin-top:4px}.watch{padding:0 16px 16px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.watch input{flex:1 1 220px}.empty{padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}@media(max-width:980px){.wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.metrics,.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:620px){.metrics,.cards,.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.head{display:grid}.head p{text-align:left}}
</style>
<style>
.danger{color:#9f1d1d;font-weight:800}
.ok{color:var(--accent);font-weight:800}
.sim-scroll{max-height:340px}
.watch select{flex:0 1 180px}
</style>
<style>
.mobile-list{display:none}
.mobile-card{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 16px;display:grid;gap:12px;background:#fff}
.mobile-card:first-child{border-top:0}
.mobile-card-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}
.mobile-card-title strong{font-size:17px}
.mobile-card-title span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.mobile-rank{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:34px;height:28px;border-radius:7px;background:#edf4f3;color:var(--accent);font-weight:800}
.mobile-kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.mobile-kv div{background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #e7edf2;border-radius:7px;padding:8px;min-width:0}
.mobile-kv span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-bottom:4px}
.mobile-kv strong{display:block;font-size:14px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mobile-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
.mobile-actions{display:none;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:3;background:#112329;padding:9px 12px;gap:8px;overflow:auto}
.mobile-actions a{flex:0 0 auto;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:760px){
body{background:#eef2f5}
header{padding:16px 14px 12px}
header h1{font-size:22px;line-height:1.2}
header p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.mobile-actions{display:flex}
.wrap{padding:12px;gap:12px}
.panel{border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(27,39,57,.07)}
.controls{gap:10px;padding:12px}
.content{gap:12px}
.metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.metric{padding:10px}
.metric strong{font-size:19px}
.head{padding:13px 14px;gap:4px}
.head h2{font-size:16px}
.head p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.45}
button,input,select{min-height:42px;font-size:15px}
.watch{padding:0 14px 14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}
.desktop-table{display:none}
.mobile-list{display:block;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:0 14px 14px}
.scores{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.notice{font-size:12px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><h1>A股自动选股实验室 V2</h1><p>已自动加载问财清洗数据。版本：2026-05-18-V2东方财富PowerShell更新版，最近更新：2026/5/20 15:30:10，已自动保存Top5。结果只用于学习和模拟观察，不构成投资建议。</p></header>
<nav class="mobile-actions"><a href="#top5Panel">Top5</a><a href="#simPanel">模拟</a><a href="#watchPanel">自选池</a><a href="#sellPanel">卖出纪律</a></nav>
<main class="wrap">
<aside class="panel controls">
<div class="field"><label>策略风格</label><select id="style"><option value="growth">中线成长股</option><option value="short" selected>短线强势股</option><option value="balanced">低估值成长混合</option><option value="defensive">稳健低估值</option></select></div>
<div class="two"><div class="field"><label>PB 上限</label><input id="pbMax" type="number" value="12" step="0.1"></div><div class="field"><label>ROE 下限 %</label><input id="roeMin" type="number" value="0" step="1"></div></div>
<div class="two"><div class="field"><label>量比下限</label><input id="volumeMin" type="number" value="0.3" step="0.1"></div><div class="field"><label>换手率下限 %</label><input id="turnoverMin" type="number" value="0.3" step="0.1"></div></div>
<div class="two"><div class="field"><label>涨幅下限 %</label><input id="changeMin" type="number" value="-5" step="0.5"></div><div class="field"><label>涨幅上限 %</label><input id="changeMax" type="number" value="9" step="0.5"></div></div>
<div class="field"><label>推荐数量</label><input id="topN" type="number" value="5" min="1" max="20"></div>
<div class="two"><div class="field"><label>止损线 %</label><input id="stopLoss" type="number" value="-5" step="0.5"></div><div class="field"><label>止盈观察 %</label><input id="takeProfit" type="number" value="8" step="0.5"></div></div>
<div class="field"><label>最长观察天数</label><input id="maxHoldDays" type="number" value="10" min="1" max="30"></div>
<button onclick="run()">重新评分</button>
<div class="notice">首要硬门槛：不考虑 ST；不考虑总市值低于 100 亿；不考虑连续三年亏损。当前问财数据已按非 ST、市值大于 100 亿导出，连续亏损年数后续继续补强。</div>
</aside>
<section class="content">
<div class="metrics"><div class="metric"><span>股票池</span><strong id="mPool">-</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>通过条件</span><strong id="mPassed">-</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>最高分</span><strong id="mTopScore">-</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>状态</span><strong id="mStatus">加载中</strong></div></div>
<div class="panel" id="watchPanel"><div class="head"><h2>股票自选池</h2><p>输入代码或名称，观察持仓/关注股是否匹配当前策略。</p></div><div class="watch"><input id="watchInput" placeholder="例如 300750、宁德时代"><button onclick="addWatch()">加入自选</button><button class="secondary" onclick="resetWatch()">清空自选池</button></div><div class="table-wrap desktop-table"><table><thead><tr><th>代码</th><th>名称</th><th>行业</th><th>状态</th><th>综合分</th><th>开盘价</th><th>收盘价</th><th>实时价</th><th>涨跌幅</th><th>PB</th><th>ROE</th><th>主力净流入</th><th>量比</th><th>换手率</th><th>判断</th></tr></thead><tbody id="watchBody"></tbody></table></div><div id="watchCards" class="mobile-list"></div></div>
<div class="panel" id="top5Panel"><div class="head"><h2>下个交易日候选 Top 5</h2><p id="status">正在加载...</p></div><div class="table-wrap desktop-table"><table><thead><tr><th>排名</th><th>代码</th><th>名称</th><th>行业</th><th>总市值</th><th>综合分</th><th>开盘价</th><th>收盘价</th><th>实时价</th><th>涨跌幅</th><th>PB</th><th>ROE</th><th>营收增长</th><th>净利增长</th><th>主力净流入</th><th>量比</th><th>换手率</th><th>风险标签</th></tr></thead><tbody id="rankBody"></tbody></table></div><div id="rankCards" class="mobile-list"></div></div>
<div class="panel" id="simPanel"><div class="head"><h2>模拟推荐记录</h2><p>同一股票多次入选会按不同买入日期分别统计。</p></div><div class="watch"><select id="simDateFilter" onchange="renderSimulation()"><option value="all">全部日期</option></select><button onclick="saveSimulation()">保存当前推荐</button><button class="secondary" onclick="clearSimulation()">清空模拟记录</button></div><div class="table-wrap sim-scroll desktop-table"><table><thead><tr><th>日期</th><th>排名</th><th>代码</th><th>名称</th><th>买入参考价</th><th>当前价</th><th>当前收益</th><th>卖出信号</th><th>止损价</th><th>止盈价</th><th>持有天数</th><th>第1交易日</th><th>第3交易日</th><th>第5交易日</th><th>第10交易日</th><th>策略</th><th>备注</th></tr></thead><tbody id="simBody"></tbody></table></div><div id="simCards" class="mobile-list"></div></div>
<div class="panel"><div class="head"><h2>模拟表现汇总</h2><p>当日收盘后新推荐不计入盈亏统计，等下一交易日再评估。</p></div><div class="metrics"><div class="metric"><span>记录数量</span><strong id="simCount">-</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>已评估样本</span><strong id="simEvaluated">-</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>当前胜率</span><strong id="simWin">-</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>平均收益</span><strong id="simAvg">-</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>最大回撤</span><strong id="simWorst">-</strong></div></div></div>
<div class="panel" id="sellPanel"><div class="head"><h2>卖出纪律</h2><p>短线模拟默认先用固定止损止盈，后续根据样本表现调整。</p></div><div class="cards"><article class="card"><h3><span>止损规则</span><span class="danger">-5%</span></h3><p>当前收益跌到止损线或更低，记录为“触发止损”。短线测试先严格执行，避免单只股票拖累整体结果。</p></article><article class="card"><h3><span>止盈规则</span><span class="neg">+8%</span></h3><p>当前收益达到止盈观察线，提示“止盈观察”。如果同时量比或换手过热，优先考虑冲高减仓。</p></article><article class="card"><h3><span>时间规则</span><span class="blue">10天</span></h3><p>超过最长观察天数仍未明显走强，提示“到期评估”，避免短线策略变成被动长线持有。</p></article><article class="card"><h3><span>趋势规则</span><span class="warm">观察</span></h3><p>若收益为负且当日继续下跌，标记为“弱势观察”；若收益为正但出现过热标签，标记为“冲高观察”。</p></article></div></div>
<div class="panel"><div class="head"><h2>五步分析</h2><p>估值ROE、财务成长、资金结构、行业政策、风险回报。</p></div><div id="cards" class="cards"></div></div>
</section>
</main>
<script>
const csvBase64='';
const autoPriceBase64='';
const autoSimBase64='';
let rows=[];let scored=[];let watchlist=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('stockQuantWatchV2')||'[]');let simRecords=mergeSimRecords(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('stockQuantSimV2')||'[]'),parseAutoSimRecords());let priceSnapshots=mergePriceSnapshots(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('stockQuantPricesV2')||'{}'),parseAutoPriceSnapshots());
function csvText(){return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(csvBase64)));}
function parse(text){return text.replace(/^\uFEFF/,'').trim().split(/\r?\n/).map(line=>line.split(','));}
function num(v){const n=Number(String(v??'').replace(/[% ,]/g,''));return Number.isFinite(n)?n:NaN;}
function fmt(n,d=1){return Number.isFinite(n)?n.toFixed(d):'-';}
function pct(n){return Number.isFinite(n)?n.toFixed(1)+'%':'-';}
function esc(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[ch]));}
function parseAutoSimRecords(){if(!autoSimBase64)return[];try{const text=decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(autoSimBase64))).replace(/^\uFEFF/,'').trim();if(!text)return[];const table=parse(text);const h=table[0];const id=n=>h.indexOf(n);return table.slice(1).map(r=>({date:r[id('日期')],rank:num(r[id('排名')]),code:r[id('代码')],name:r[id('名称')],style:r[id('策略')],buy:num(r[id('买入参考价')]),score:num(r[id('综合分')]),note:r[id('备注')]})).filter(r=>r.date&&r.code&&Number.isFinite(r.buy));}catch(e){console.warn('自动模拟记录读取失败',e);return[];}}
function parseAutoPriceSnapshots(){if(!autoPriceBase64)return{};try{const text=decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(autoPriceBase64))).replace(/^\uFEFF/,'').trim();if(!text)return{};const table=parse(text);const h=table[0];const id=n=>h.indexOf(n);const out={};table.slice(1).forEach(r=>{const d=r[id('日期')],code=r[id('代码')],price=num(r[id('价格')]);if(d&&code&&Number.isFinite(price)){out[d]=out[d]||{};out[d][code]=price;}});return out;}catch(e){console.warn('价格快照读取失败',e);return{};}}
function mergePriceSnapshots(localRows,autoRows){const merged={...localRows};Object.keys(autoRows).forEach(d=>{merged[d]={...(merged[d]||{}),...autoRows[d]};});localStorage.setItem('stockQuantPricesV2',JSON.stringify(merged));return merged;}
function mergeSimRecords(localRows,autoRows){const canonicalDates=new Set(autoRows.map(r=>r.date+'|'+r.style));const map=new Map();[...autoRows,...localRows.filter(r=>!canonicalDates.has(r.date+'|'+r.style))].forEach(r=>{const key=r.date+'|'+r.code+'|'+r.style;if(!map.has(key))map.set(key,r)});const merged=[...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>(a.date===b.date?a.rank-b.rank:a.date.localeCompare(b.date)));localStorage.setItem('stockQuantSimV2',JSON.stringify(merged));return merged;}
function load(){const table=parse(csvText());const h=table[0];const id=n=>h.indexOf(n);rows=table.slice(1).map(r=>({code:r[id('代码')],name:r[id('名称')],industry:r[id('行业')],cap:num(r[id('总市值亿')]),isST:r[id('是否ST')]==='是',lossYears:num(r[id('连续亏损年数')]),close:num(r[id('收盘价')]),real:num(r[id('实时价格')]),change:num(r[id('涨跌幅')]),open:num(r[id('今日开盘价')]),price:num(r[id('实时价格')]),pb:num(r[id('PB')]),roe:num(r[id('ROE')]),revenue:num(r[id('营收增长')]),profit:num(r[id('净利润增长')]),flow:num(r[id('主力净流入20日')]),vol:num(r[id('量比')]),turn:num(r[id('换手率')]),risk:r[id('风险说明')],trackingOnly:String(r[id('风险说明')]||'').includes('历史模拟记录补充行情')})).filter(s=>s.code&&s.name);savePriceSnapshot();run();}
function hardPass(s){return !s.trackingOnly&&!s.isST&&s.cap>=100&&(!Number.isFinite(s.lossYears)||s.lossYears<3);}
function safe(v,fallback){return Number.isFinite(v)?v:fallback;}
function clamp(v){return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,v));}
function score(s,style){const pb=safe(s.pb,8),roe=safe(s.roe,10),revenue=safe(s.revenue,0),profit=safe(s.profit,0),flow=safe(s.flow,0),vol=safe(s.vol,1),turn=safe(s.turn,2),change=safe(s.change,0);const valuation=clamp((8-pb)/8*45+55)*0.45+clamp((roe-8)/18*55+45)*0.55;const financial=clamp(((revenue/100000000)+profit)/2*0.02+55);const market=clamp(flow*2+50)*0.42+clamp(vol*30+40)*0.28+clamp(turn*5+45)*0.30;const industry=60;const riskPenalty=(pb>12?8:0)+(change>=7?4:0)+(vol>=3?3:0)+(turn>=15?4:0);const riskReward=clamp(valuation*.22+financial*.22+market*.42+industry*.14-riskPenalty);const w=style==='short'?{v:.1,f:.16,m:.48,i:.08,r:.18}:style==='defensive'?{v:.3,f:.3,m:.18,i:.1,r:.12}:style==='balanced'?{v:.23,f:.25,m:.28,i:.1,r:.14}:{v:.17,f:.28,m:.28,i:.15,r:.12};const total=valuation*w.v+financial*w.f+market*w.m+industry*w.i+riskReward*w.r;return{valuation,financial,market,industry,riskReward,total};}
function config(){return{style:document.getElementById('style').value,pbMax:num(document.getElementById('pbMax').value),roeMin:num(document.getElementById('roeMin').value),volumeMin:num(document.getElementById('volumeMin').value),turnoverMin:num(document.getElementById('turnoverMin').value),changeMin:num(document.getElementById('changeMin').value),changeMax:num(document.getElementById('changeMax').value),topN:num(document.getElementById('topN').value)||5,stopLoss:num(document.getElementById('stopLoss').value)||-5,takeProfit:num(document.getElementById('takeProfit').value)||8,maxHoldDays:num(document.getElementById('maxHoldDays').value)||10};}
function passSoft(s,c){const roeOk=!Number.isFinite(s.roe)||s.roe>=c.roeMin;const pbOk=!Number.isFinite(s.pb)||s.pb<=c.pbMax;return pbOk&&roeOk&&s.vol>=c.volumeMin&&s.turn>=c.turnoverMin&&s.change>=c.changeMin&&s.change<=c.changeMax;}
function riskTag(s){const tags=[];if(s.change>=6)tags.push('涨幅偏高');if(s.change<=-2)tags.push('弱势回落');if(s.vol>=2.5)tags.push('量比过热');if(s.turn>=12)tags.push('换手过高');if(s.flow>0&&s.change>=5)tags.push('资金追高');if(!tags.length)tags.push('正常');return tags.join(' / ');}
function run(){const c=config();scored=rows.filter(hardPass).filter(s=>passSoft(s,c)).map(s=>({...s,score:score(s,c.style)})).sort((a,b)=>b.score.total-a.score.total);const top=scored.slice(0,c.topN);document.getElementById('mPool').textContent=rows.length;document.getElementById('mPassed').textContent=scored.length;document.getElementById('mTopScore').textContent=top[0]?fmt(top[0].score.total,1):'-';document.getElementById('mStatus').textContent='已加载';document.getElementById('status').textContent='已加载问财清洗数据 '+rows.length+' 只，当前条件通过 '+scored.length+' 只。';renderRank(top);renderCards(top);renderWatch();renderSimulation();}
function cnColor(value){return value>=0?'neg':'pos';}
function renderRank(list){document.getElementById('rankBody').innerHTML=list.map((s,i)=>'<tr><td>'+ (i+1) +'</td><td>'+s.code+'</td><td>'+esc(s.name)+'</td><td><span class="tag">'+esc(s.industry)+'</span></td><td>'+fmt(s.cap,0)+'亿</td><td class="blue">'+fmt(s.score.total,1)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.open,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.close,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.real,2)+'</td><td class="'+cnColor(s.change)+'">'+pct(s.change)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.pb,2)+'</td><td class="neg">'+pct(s.roe)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.revenue/100000000,1)+'亿</td><td>'+fmt(s.profit,1)+'%</td><td class="'+cnColor(s.flow)+'">'+fmt(s.flow,2)+'亿</td><td>'+fmt(s.vol,2)+'</td><td>'+pct(s.turn)+'</td><td><span class="tag">'+esc(riskTag(s))+'</span></td></tr>').join('')||'<tr><td colspan="18" class="empty">没有股票通过当前条件，可以放宽 PB、ROE、量比、换手率或涨幅限制。</td></tr>';renderRankCards(list);}
function renderRankCards(list){const el=document.getElementById('rankCards');if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=list.map((s,i)=>'<article class="mobile-card"><div class="mobile-card-title"><div><strong>'+esc(s.name)+'</strong><span>'+s.code+' · '+esc(s.industry)+'</span></div><b class="mobile-rank">#'+(i+1)+'</b></div><div class="mobile-kv"><div><span>综合分</span><strong class="blue">'+fmt(s.score.total,1)+'</strong></div><div><span>实时价</span><strong>'+fmt(s.real,2)+'</strong></div><div><span>涨跌幅</span><strong class="'+cnColor(s.change)+'">'+pct(s.change)+'</strong></div><div><span>主力净流入</span><strong class="'+cnColor(s.flow)+'">'+fmt(s.flow,2)+'亿</strong></div><div><span>量比</span><strong>'+fmt(s.vol,2)+'</strong></div><div><span>换手率</span><strong>'+pct(s.turn)+'</strong></div></div><div class="mobile-note">PB '+fmt(s.pb,2)+' · ROE '+pct(s.roe)+' · '+esc(riskTag(s))+'</div></article>').join('')||'<div class="empty">没有股票通过当前条件，可以稍微放宽筛选。</div>';}
function reason(s){const r=[];if(s.pb<=8&&s.roe>=8)r.push('估值和ROE通过基础条件');if(s.flow>0&&s.vol>=0.5)r.push('近月资金流和量比有支撑');if(s.turn>=0.5)r.push('换手率满足活跃度要求');return r.join('，')+'。短线风险标签：'+riskTag(s)+'。主要风险：问财数据仍需补充资产负债率、连续亏损年数和更完整行业政策评分。';}
function renderCards(list){document.getElementById('cards').innerHTML=list.map((s,i)=>'<article class="card"><h3><span>'+ (i+1)+'. '+esc(s.name)+' '+s.code+'</span><span class="blue">'+fmt(s.score.total,1)+'分</span></h3><div class="scores"><div class="score"><span>估值ROE</span><strong>'+fmt(s.score.valuation,0)+'</strong></div><div class="score"><span>财务成长</span><strong>'+fmt(s.score.financial,0)+'</strong></div><div class="score"><span>资金结构</span><strong>'+fmt(s.score.market,0)+'</strong></div><div class="score"><span>行业政策</span><strong>'+fmt(s.score.industry,0)+'</strong></div><div class="score"><span>风险回报</span><strong>'+fmt(s.score.riskReward,0)+'</strong></div></div><p>'+reason(s)+'</p></article>').join('')||'<div class="empty">暂无五步分析。</div>';}
function findStock(k){const key=String(k).trim().toLowerCase();return rows.find(s=>s.code.toLowerCase()===key||s.name.toLowerCase()===key);}
function addWatch(){const raw=document.getElementById('watchInput').value;raw.split(/[,，、\s]+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(k=>{const s=findStock(k);const key=s?s.code:k;if(!watchlist.includes(key))watchlist.push(key)});localStorage.setItem('stockQuantWatchV2',JSON.stringify(watchlist));document.getElementById('watchInput').value='';renderWatch();}
function resetWatch(){watchlist=[];localStorage.setItem('stockQuantWatchV2','[]');renderWatch();}
function renderWatch(){const c=config();const cards=[];document.getElementById('watchBody').innerHTML=watchlist.map(k=>{const s=findStock(k);if(!s){cards.push({missing:true,key:k});return'<tr><td>'+esc(k)+'</td><td colspan="14" class="warm">未在当前数据中找到</td></tr>';}const sc=score(s,c.style);const ok=hardPass(s)&&passSoft(s,c);cards.push({s,sc,ok});return'<tr><td>'+s.code+'</td><td>'+esc(s.name)+'</td><td><span class="tag">'+esc(s.industry)+'</span></td><td class="'+(ok?'neg':'warm')+'">'+(ok?'可跟踪':'观察')+'</td><td class="blue">'+fmt(sc.total,1)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.open,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.close,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.real,2)+'</td><td class="'+cnColor(s.change)+'">'+pct(s.change)+'</td><td>'+fmt(s.pb,2)+'</td><td>'+pct(s.roe)+'</td><td class="'+cnColor(s.flow)+'">'+fmt(s.flow,2)+'亿</td><td>'+fmt(s.vol,2)+'</td><td>'+pct(s.turn)+'</td><td>'+(ok?'通过当前策略条件':'未完全通过当前条件')+'</td></tr>'}).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="15" class="empty">还没有自选股票。</td></tr>';renderWatchCards(cards);}
function renderWatchCards(cards){const el=document.getElementById('watchCards');if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=cards.map(item=>{if(item.missing)return'<article class="mobile-card"><div class="mobile-card-title"><div><strong>'+esc(item.key)+'</strong><span>未在当前数据中找到</span></div><b class="mobile-rank">观察</b></div></article>';const s=item.s;return'<article class="mobile-card"><div class="mobile-card-title"><div><strong>'+esc(s.name)+'</strong><span>'+s.code+' · '+esc(s.industry)+'</span></div><b class="mobile-rank">'+(item.ok?'通过':'观察')+'</b></div><div class="mobile-kv"><div><span>综合分</span><strong class="blue">'+fmt(item.sc.total,1)+'</strong></div><div><span>实时价</span><strong>'+fmt(s.real,2)+'</strong></div><div><span>涨跌幅</span><strong class="'+cnColor(s.change)+'">'+pct(s.change)+'</strong></div><div><span>主力净流入</span><strong class="'+cnColor(s.flow)+'">'+fmt(s.flow,2)+'亿</strong></div></div><div class="mobile-note">'+(item.ok?'通过当前策略条件':'未完全通过当前条件')+'</div></article>'}).join('')||'<div class="empty">还没有自选股票。</div>';}
function today(){const d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');}
function addDays(dateText,days){const d=new Date(dateText+'T00:00:00');d.setDate(d.getDate()+days);return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');}
function savePriceSnapshot(){const date=today();priceSnapshots[date]=priceSnapshots[date]||{};rows.forEach(s=>{const p=s.real||s.close||s.price;if(Number.isFinite(p))priceSnapshots[date][s.code]=p});localStorage.setItem('stockQuantPricesV2',JSON.stringify(priceSnapshots));}
function snapshotPrice(code,date){return priceSnapshots[date]&&Number.isFinite(priceSnapshots[date][code])?priceSnapshots[date][code]:NaN;}
function saveSimulation(){const c=config();const date=today();const exists=new Set(simRecords.map(r=>r.date+'|'+r.code+'|'+r.style));scored.slice(0,c.topN).forEach((s,i)=>{const key=date+'|'+s.code+'|'+c.style;if(!exists.has(key)){simRecords.push({date,rank:i+1,code:s.code,name:s.name,style:c.style,buy:s.real||s.close||s.price,score:s.score.total,note:(c.style==='short'?'短线测试保存；':'按当前Top推荐保存；')+riskTag(s)})}});localStorage.setItem('stockQuantSimV2',JSON.stringify(simRecords));renderSimulation();}
function clearSimulation(){simRecords=[];localStorage.setItem('stockQuantSimV2','[]');renderSimulation();}
function ret(now,buy){return Number.isFinite(now)&&Number.isFinite(buy)&&buy>0?(now-buy)/buy*100:NaN;}
function tradingDatesAfter(dateText){return Object.keys(priceSnapshots).filter(d=>d>dateText).sort();}
function periodReturn(r,days){const target=tradingDatesAfter(r.date)[days-1];const p=target?snapshotPrice(r.code,target):NaN;return ret(p,r.buy);}
function retCell(value){return Number.isFinite(value)?'<td class="'+cnColor(value)+'">'+pct(value)+'</td>':'<td class="warm">待更新</td>';}
function holdDays(dateText){return Math.max(0,Math.floor((new Date(today()+'T00:00:00')-new Date(dateText+'T00:00:00'))/86400000));}
function exitPlan(r,s,rr){const c=config();const days=holdDays(r.date);if(!Number.isFinite(rr))return{label:'待更新',cls:'warm'};if(rr<=c.stopLoss)return{label:'触发止损',cls:'danger'};if(rr>=c.takeProfit)return{label:(s&&(s.vol>=2.5||s.turn>=12)?'止盈/冲高':'止盈观察'),cls:'neg'};if(days>=c.maxHoldDays)return{label:'到期评估',cls:'warm'};if(s&&rr<0&&s.change<0)return{label:'弱势观察',cls:'warm'};if(s&&rr>0&&(s.vol>=2.5||s.turn>=12))return{label:'冲高观察',cls:'warm'};return{label:'继续持有',cls:'ok'};}
function refreshSimDateFilter(){const el=document.getElementById('simDateFilter');if(!el)return;const selected=el.value||'all';const dates=[...new Set(simRecords.map(r=>r.date))].sort();el.innerHTML='<option value="all">全部日期</option>'+dates.map(d=>'<option value="'+d+'">'+d+'</option>').join('');el.value=dates.includes(selected)?selected:'all';}
function renderSimulation(){refreshSimDateFilter();const filter=document.getElementById('simDateFilter')?.value||'all';const visible=filter==='all'?simRecords:simRecords.filter(r=>r.date===filter);const evaluated=[];const cardRows=[];document.getElementById('simBody').innerHTML=visible.map(r=>{const s=findStock(r.code);const now=s?(s.real||s.close||s.price):NaN;const rr=ret(now,r.buy);if(Number.isFinite(rr)&&holdDays(r.date)>0)evaluated.push(rr);const plan=exitPlan(r,s,rr);const c=config();const stop=r.buy*(1+c.stopLoss/100);const take=r.buy*(1+c.takeProfit/100);const currentCell=holdDays(r.date)>0?'<td class="'+cnColor(rr)+'">'+pct(rr)+'</td>':'<td class="warm">待次日</td>';cardRows.push({r,now,rr,plan,stop,take});return'<tr><td>'+r.date+'</td><td>'+r.rank+'</td><td>'+r.code+'</td><td>'+esc(r.name)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.buy,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(now,2)+'</td>'+currentCell+'<td class="'+plan.cls+'">'+plan.label+'</td><td>'+fmt(stop,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(take,2)+'</td><td>'+holdDays(r.date)+'</td>'+retCell(periodReturn(r,1))+retCell(periodReturn(r,3))+retCell(periodReturn(r,5))+retCell(periodReturn(r,10))+'<td>'+esc(r.style)+'</td><td>'+esc(r.note)+'</td></tr>'}).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="17" class="empty">当前日期没有模拟记录。</td></tr>';renderSimCards(cardRows);renderSimSummary(evaluated);}
function renderSimCards(cardRows){const el=document.getElementById('simCards');if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=cardRows.map(item=>{const r=item.r;const cur=holdDays(r.date)>0?'<strong class="'+cnColor(item.rr)+'">'+pct(item.rr)+'</strong>':'<strong class="warm">待次日</strong>';return'<article class="mobile-card"><div class="mobile-card-title"><div><strong>'+esc(r.name)+'</strong><span>'+r.date+' · #'+r.rank+' · '+r.code+'</span></div><b class="mobile-rank">'+item.plan.label+'</b></div><div class="mobile-kv"><div><span>买入参考价</span><strong>'+fmt(r.buy,2)+'</strong></div><div><span>当前价</span><strong>'+fmt(item.now,2)+'</strong></div><div><span>当前收益</span>'+cur+'</div><div><span>持有天数</span><strong>'+holdDays(r.date)+'</strong></div><div><span>第1交易日</span><strong class="'+cnColor(periodReturn(r,1))+'">'+(Number.isFinite(periodReturn(r,1))?pct(periodReturn(r,1)):'待更新')+'</strong></div><div><span>第3交易日</span><strong class="'+cnColor(periodReturn(r,3))+'">'+(Number.isFinite(periodReturn(r,3))?pct(periodReturn(r,3)):'待更新')+'</strong></div></div><div class="mobile-note">止损 '+fmt(item.stop,2)+' · 止盈观察 '+fmt(item.take,2)+' · '+esc(r.note)+'</div></article>'}).join('')||'<div class="empty">当前日期没有模拟记录。</div>';}
function renderSimSummary(returns){const count=simRecords.length;const valid=returns.filter(Number.isFinite);const wins=valid.filter(v=>v>0).length;const avg=valid.length?valid.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/valid.length:NaN;const worst=valid.length?Math.min(...valid):NaN;document.getElementById('simCount').textContent=count;document.getElementById('simEvaluated').textContent=valid.length;document.getElementById('simWin').textContent=valid.length?pct(wins/valid.length*100):'-';document.getElementById('simAvg').textContent=Number.isFinite(avg)?pct(avg):'-';document.getElementById('simWorst').textContent=Number.isFinite(worst)?pct(worst):'-';}
['style','pbMax','roeMin','volumeMin','turnoverMin','changeMin','changeMax','topN','stopLoss','takeProfit','maxHoldDays'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change',run));
load();
</script>
</body>
</html>
